description:
Get the follower or engaged-audience breakdown by age, city, country or gender.

These are lifetime metrics and a breakdown is mandatory. Meta withholds demographics for accounts under roughly 100 followers, which comes back as an empty result rather than an error.

Example: "where are our followers" -> metric="follower_demographics", breakdown="country"

account_id.description: Instagram professional account ID. Omit to use the token's own account.

breakdown.description: Dimension to break the audience down by

metric.description: 'follower_demographics' profiles everyone who follows the account; 'engaged_audience_demographics' profiles only accounts that engaged.

response_format.description: 'markdown' for readable text, 'json' for structured data

timeframe.description: Window Meta computes the demographic over. Only this_week and this_month are supported for engaged_audience_demographics since v20.0.

name: instagram_get_audience_demographics
title: Get Audience Demographics
